sources.entry: Screego - Screego is a simple tool to quickly share your screen to one or multiple people via web browser. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: Screego is a self-hostable tool for sharing your screen with one or more people through a web browser, aimed at developers who need low-latency, readable screen shares.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes screen sharing to multiple users over WebRTC with a stated focus on high resolution and low latency. It is presented as an add-on to existing chat software, handling only the screen sharing part. Installation is offered via Docker or as a single binary. The project includes an integrated TURN server for NAT traversal. The README links to a demo/public instance, installation notes and configuration docs, but the details of those pages are not included in the README text itself.
use_cases: share your screen with coworkers during code reviews
show code to colleagues with low lag
replace laggy corporate screen sharing in chat apps
self-host a browser-based screen sharing server
how_to_run: Install via Docker (see installation docs linked from the README)
Or download and run the single binary (see installation docs)
Configure via the configuration docs linked from the README
notable: Multi-user screen sharing via web browser
Integrated TURN server for NAT traversal
Built for high resolution and low latency compared with corporate chat screen sharing
caveats: README does not state platform or OS requirements
Installation and configuration details are only in linked docs, not in the README
Described as an addition to other software; it does not provide chat or other communication features
